equity.level_reason: Only age (<15 vs ≥15 years) and sex are compared, without social-position framing; HIV treatment status is clinical. Stigma and distance explanations concern ART-naive clients, not an SPD group.

level_alternative.reason: Recommendations to identify underserved subpopulations and improve access could be read as equity raised only as a recommendation.

ev.q: disaggregated by age group (<15 and ≥15 years), sex, and HIV treatment status
No statistically significant differences existed in overall TPT initiation or completion rates between sex and age groups

equity.equity_measurement: Age only in two broad bands (<15, ≥15 years); data are aggregate, not person-level; country income or region not analyzed.

notes: Mann-Whitney tests appear to compare distributions of semiannual aggregate rates between strata (Figure 2 box plots); the unit of analysis is not stated. The UNHLM target is cited only in the Discussion, so it is not a referent. Design inferred as program monitoring against PEPFAR's commitment.
view_issues: Summary says initiation rates peaked in FY19, while the count of initiations peaked in FY21 Q4; the text is consistent on this but the wording can confuse. One country was excluded from FY23 Q4 completion data.
